shared_rules: Decides after each US close with that day's data only; orders fill at the next trading day's official opening price.
Euros: 1 € fee per buy and per sell, half the estimated spread each way, US prices converted with the EUR/USD rate (FRED).
Whole shares only; money left over stays as cash.
Only stocks eligible for signals, not blocked by an event, never SELL / RISK WARNING. A holding that turns SELL / RISK WARNING is sold like a stop.
Keeps a stock at least 3 trading days unless a stop triggers, and does not buy back a stock it sold in the last 5 trading days.
Switches only if the new stock's score is ahead by the strategy's margin AND its expected 1-month gain beats the holding's by more than the cost of switching (both fees and spreads).

benchmark.mindset: The yardstick: 200 € into the S&P 500 at the first open, one buy fee, then held.
rules: Buys SPY (an S&P 500 fund) with all 200 € at the first open (a fraction of a share: one share costs more than 200 €; SPY itself is not sold to EU investors, it is only the yardstick), then holds.

strategies.name: Best overall (Balanced)
strategies.mindset: Buys the best all-round stocks: safe enough, enough upside, and a validated chance of rising.
rules: Up to 2 stocks, ranked by the Picks Balanced score (only stocks that pass the Picks minimum of 40 on Safety, Upside and Confidence).
Buys only with a validated chance up (1 month) of at least 52% and an expected 1-month gain larger than the round-trip cost.
Sells at +8% (take-profit), −6% (stop), when the Balanced score falls below 60, when the label turns SELL, or after 63 trading days.

strategies.mindset: Goes for the biggest possible 1-month jump and accepts big swings.
